articles.title: Alex Pereira Can Become the GOAT #ufc
articles.description: Could Alex Pereira make a legitimate argument as the greatest MMA fighter of all time? Chael Sonnen believes winning the UFC heavyweight championship would put Pereira in that conversation. Becoming a champion in another division would add another extraordinary accomplishment to an already remarkable career. But Chael was surprised by Pereira's recent comments about potentially returning to 205 pounds if things don't work out against Sergei Pavlovich. Pereira also acknowledged that he's not a particularly big heavyweight, raising questions about how committed he is to staying in the division. Chael believes Pereira should be focused on one thing: winning the heavyweight championship. Is Pereira simply a competitor who doesn't want to walk away, or is he already thinking about what comes next if the heavyweight experiment doesn't work? One more championship could change the way we talk about Alex Pereira's legacy forever. #ChaelSonnen #AlexPereira #UFC #MMA #UFCHeavyweight #GOAT #MMAHistory #SergeiPavlovich #UFCNews

articles.title: ‘I’m Proud! 🥹’ DJ Breaks Down Winged C’s First Pro Win
Was Ciryl Gane Really Trying to Poke Him in the Eye? #ufc
articles.description: Was that eye poke intentional, or was it simply an accident? Chael Sonnen weighs in on the controversy surrounding Ciryl Gane and argues that he doesn't believe Gane deliberately poked his opponent in the eye. Chael takes a different approach to the debate, questioning whether any fighter is athletic enough to intentionally target something as small as an opponent's eye while both men are constantly moving inside the Octagon. His argument comes down to geometry, timing, and the difficulty of making contact with such a small target during a fight. Gane may have made contact, but Chael doesn't believe that automatically makes him a cheater. It's a controversial perspective on one of MMA's most frustrating problems: accidental eye pokes and the damage they can do to a fight. Was it intentional, or are fans too quick to assume the worst? #ChaelSonnen #CirylGane #UFC #MMA #EyePoke #MMAControversy #UFCNews #MMAAnalysis

articles.title: Nobody Is Safe From Josh Hokit
articles.description: Josh Hokit just released an AI-generated rap video, and Chael Sonnen thinks it's one of the most creative things a UFC fighter has done to promote himself. The video takes shots at Ciryl Gane, Jon Jones, and even Ilia Topuria, while somehow finding room for every one of Hokit's sponsors. But instead of feeling like an advertisement, it works as entertainment. Chael explains why that's such a big deal. Hokit and his team have found a way to promote a potential heavyweight title fight, build interest in the division, and support the UFC's own marketing efforts without waiting for the promotion to do it for them. And that's only the beginning. While Alexander Volkov, Sergei Pavlovich, and Alex Pereira have their own championship ambitions, Hokit is doing something different. He's calling people out, creating rivalries, and making sure nobody in the division can ignore him. First, he has to get past Ciryl Gane, and Chael isn't overlooking how difficult that challenge will be. articles.title: Big Dan Got the Moicano Stoppage RIGHT!
articles.description: Renato Moicano was in a dominant position against Tom Nolan when referee Big Dan Miragliotta made a controversial decision: he stood the fighters back up. Moments later, Moicano was caught and knocked down. Was the referee wrong to take away Moicano's position? Chael Sonnen says absolutely not. Chael breaks down why having a dominant position doesn't automatically mean a fighter gets to stay there indefinitely. The referee had warned both athletes that they needed to advance the fight, and when Moicano failed to create meaningful offense, Big Dan followed through. Chael also revisits a similar controversy involving Roy Nelson and Andrei Arlovski, when a referee stood the fighters up despite Nelson having side control. The decision was unpopular, but Chael argues that an unfamiliar call isn't necessarily wrong. And here's the biggest surprise: Renato Moicano agrees with the referee. Chael explains why Big Dan made the right decision, why Moicano deserves credit for acknowledging it, and why the MMA community needs to reconsider how it judges referee stand-ups. #RenatoMoicano #TomNolan #ChaelSonnen #BigDanMiragliotta #UFC #MMA Bad Guy Inc merch now available at https://BadGuyInc.com Click here to subscribe: https://bit.ly/3FrHIPK Follow me on IG: https://bit.ly/3HY7BIE Follow me on Twitter: https://bit.ly/3tvY5J7 Follow me on Threads https://www.threads.com/@sonnench

articles.title: Conor McGregor’s Return: Max or Michael Chandler? #ufc
articles.description: Is Conor McGregor coming back to fight Max Holloway or Michael Chandler? Chael Sonnen believes Chandler is still very much in the picture, but he has a feeling that when it comes down to making a decision, Conor will choose Max Holloway. Conor’s coach, John Kavanagh, has recently spoken about McGregor’s return, suggesting that he isn't finished competing and that if anyone can make a comeback, Conor can. Chael points out that Max is on board. Chandler is on board. But there's one more important piece to this puzzle: Dana White. And that's where the conversation gets interesting. Is the UFC ready to bring Conor McGregor back? Which opponent makes the most sense? And does Dana have the final say in whether this comeback actually happens? articles.title: What Would an Arman Win Mean for Gaethje’s Legacy? #ufc
articles.description: What if Justin Gaethje beats Arman Tsarukyan and then decides to walk away from MMA? Chael Sonnen raises a bigger question about Gaethje’s future, his legacy, and what one more victory could mean for the UFC lightweight division. Chael points out that the MMA community has a strange relationship with Gaethje. Fans love watching him fight, but every time he steps into the Octagon, there seems to be another reason to doubt him. Against Arman, Gaethje likely won't be the favorite. But what happens if he proves everyone wrong again? Would a victory change the entire division? Would it add another defining moment to his legacy? And would Gaethje consider fighting one more time? At some point, every fighter has to walk away. Chael questions why Gaethje should have to do it after a defeat instead of choosing to leave after a major victory. **Could Justin Gaethje retire on top after beating Arman Tsarukyan?** #ChaelSonnen #JustinGaethje #ArmanTsarukyan #UFC #MMA #UFCNews #MMAAnalysis #UFCLightweight

articles.title: What If Justin Gaethje BEATS Arman Tsarukyan?
articles.description: What happens if Justin Gaethje beats Arman Tsarukyan? Gaethje has openly said he's deciding between another fight and retirement, and if he does fight again, Arman appears to be the opponent. But once again, the MMA community is preparing to count Gaethje out. We do this every time. Gaethje was doubted against Rafael Fiziev. He was doubted going into an interim title fight. And if he faces Arman, he'll likely be the underdog again. But what if he wins? Does Gaethje take another fight? Does he walk away on top? And what would beating Arman at this stage do for his legacy? Alexander Volkanovski has also publicly called Gaethje out and Gaethje's lack of response might be telling us something about where his head is right now. Whatever Gaethje decides, Chael Sonnen believes the community should make one thing clear: it's okay. Fight Arman, fight Volk, or walk away. He's earned the right to choose. #JustinGaethje #ArmanTsarukyan #UFC #ChaelSonnen

articles.description: Zachary Reese speaks to the media following his victory over Mickey Gall at UFC Vegas 123 on Halloween night, October 31, 2026, at the Meta Apex in Las Vegas. 🤒 REESE REVEALS HE FOUGHT THROUGH ILLNESS Reese discusses overcoming sickness during fight week, explaining how previous experiences fighting through illness helped him stay mentally focused against Mickey Gall. 🥊 POINT DEDUCTION & FIGHT CONTROVERSY Reese addresses losing a point in the opening round, his thoughts on stricter enforcement of fouls, and why he believes fighters should be held accountable for illegal strikes. 🍺 STONE COLD STEVE AUSTIN HALLOWEEN COSTUME! Dressed as WWE legend “Stone Cold” Steve Austin, Reese jokes about wanting to bring beers to his walkout, gives a shoutout to his wife for making the costume, and delivers his own hilarious version of Austin’s famous catchphrase! 0:00 Sticking through adversity 0:23 Fighting through illness 0:55 The first-round point deduction 1:21 Mickey Gall's willingness to engage 1:39 Snapping the two-fight skid 2:28 Returning January 18 in Dallas 2:48 The Stone Cold Steve Austin costume 3:14 Halloween karaoke plans 3:27 Walking out with a beer 3:51 Foot in a boot 4:04 Broken nose and a late headbutt 4:28 Sparring at Xtreme Couture 5:25 Who he wants in Dallas 5:42 Pulling up his shorts 6:11 The oblique kick ban debate 6:52 Overcoming the fouls mentally 7:19 What is Reese 3:16? 📍 UFC Vegas 123: Moicano vs. Nolan 📅 October 31, 2026 🏟️ Meta Apex | Las Vegas, Nevada 💬 QUESTION: Should Zachary Reese get another fight in January after this performance? 👇 Let us know in the comments!
